title: alnus jorullensis var. ferruginea
intro: Alnus jorullensis var. ferruginea, commonly known as the Red Alder, is a variant of the Alnus jorullensis tree, a species of alder native to Mexico. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alnus jorullensis var. ferruginea include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and calm muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of Alnus jorullensis var. ferruginea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
